description: Describes the structure of a Google Sheets spreadsheet without reading any cell. Takes the spreadsheet ID. Returns the spreadsheet's title, locale, time zone and link, and one entry per tab in tab order: its title, its numeric sheetId, its position, its type, whether it is hidden, its grid size in rows and columns, and how many rows and columns are frozen. The title is what range arguments name a tab by; the sheetId is what sheets_batch_update requests address a tab by. Cell values, formulas and formatting are not part of the response at any spreadsheet size.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

name: gws-mcp__sheets_get_metadata
